correctness.rationale: The trace identity Tr(T_E T_F)=pi^-2∫_E∫_F exp(-|z-w|²) dxdy follows from Fock reproducing kernel. In tangential/normal variables y1=R^(1-1/p)u, y2=y1+h, inward s,t>=0, the measure carries R^(1-1/p) and horizontal separation tends to g+(a+b)|u|^p+s+t. Unique contact and compact convexity furnish lower bound c|u|^p on normal support deficits, and exp(-h²-(c|u|^p+s+t)²) is integrable. Dominated convergence is locally uniform in g; integrating h gives sqrt(pi), normal s,t a v weight, and tangential u integral yields 2p/((p+1)(a+b)^(1/p))q^(1+1/p). At g=0 Gamma integral matches. Independently evaluated p=2,4,6 normalized gap-zero constants by numerical integration, agreeing with Gamma identity to 2.5e-16. Finite quadrature is not proof of the all-body asymptotic.
